title: Universal Unit & Inventory Engine
description: Visual unit mapping, dynamic availability grids, and flexible categorization for lockers, rooms, bays, and toolkits.
detailedOverview: Manage any physical rental asset effortlessly. Whether you are dividing a 50,000 sq ft warehouse into sub-bays, tracking individual beds in a co-living property, or renting out construction excavators, our universal schema models units with customized attributes, rates, and occupancy timelines.
keyBenefits: Visual interactive 2D floor plans and layout maps
Instant state transitions (Available, Reserved, Rented, Maintenance)
Bulk price adjustments and multi-unit batch operations
Custom spec filters (dimensions, power, climate control, weight capacity)
stats: Cuts unit onboarding and inventory audit time by 65%

title: Recurring Invoicing & Multi-Gateway Billing
description: Seamless auto-pay, prorated billing, automated security deposit holding, and unified tax calculation.
detailedOverview: Eliminate manual payment chasing with automated recurring charge runs, SMS/WhatsApp invoice delivery, and smart retry schedules for failed cards. Integrates with Stripe, Razorpay, and direct ACH bank transfers.
keyBenefits: Automated prorated invoices for mid-month move-ins/outs
Smart dunning workflows with WhatsApp and SMS reminders
Security deposit escrow handling with digital damage deduction
One-click export to QuickBooks, Xero, and CSV reports
stats: Reduces late payments and overdue balances by 84%

title: AI Dynamic Pricing & Yield Optimizer
description: Autonomous price elasticity models that continuously calibrate rates based on seasonality, occupancy, and local competition.
detailedOverview: Never leave money on the table. Our machine learning agents analyze historical booking curves, regional competitors, and current demand velocity to suggest and optionally auto-adjust rental rates in real-time.
keyBenefits: Automated surge pricing during peak leasing windows
Promotional discount pacing for low-velocity inventory units
Competitor price tracking and regional market index matching
What-If simulator to forecast revenue prior to rate adjustments
stats: +18.4% average annual net operating income increase

title: IoT Smart Locks & Keyless Access
description: Direct hardware integration with smart locks, Bluetooth gates, ANPR barrier cameras, and QR turnstiles.
detailedOverview: Deliver a frictionless self-service move-in experience. Once an agreement is digitally signed and payment verified, RentallQ automatically provisions a time-bounded PIN, Bluetooth token, or license plate permit.
keyBenefits: Instant lock release upon verified payment and KYC approval
Automatic access revocation upon lease expiration or overdue balance
Full audit trail of entry/exit timestamps with camera snapshot sync
Works with major access systems: Kisi, PTI Security, Salto, Nuki, PDK

title: Predictive Maintenance & Asset Health
description: IoT sensor telemetry, machinery hour monitoring, and preventative maintenance ticketing.
detailedOverview: Prevent costly downtime before equipment fails. Telemetry ingestion triggers automated work orders when engine hours hit service intervals or when HVAC sensors detect anomalous temperature spikes in climate units.
keyBenefits: Automated maintenance dispatch to on-call vendor contractors
Engine telemetry, battery level, and vibration monitoring
Tenant photo-upload repair requests with AI severity triage
Maintenance expense tracking against unit profitability
stats: Decreases emergency repairs by 42% and extends asset life

title: White-Label Customer & Tenant Portal
description: Self-service customer portal for booking, digital lease signing, bill pay, and support ticket management.
detailedOverview: Empower your renters with a branded mobile-responsive portal. Customers can view invoices, change payment methods, unlock gates, extend leases, and request unit upgrades in seconds.
keyBenefits: Legally-binding e-signature lease execution built-in
One-click lease renewals, extensions, and automated check-outs
Custom domain & company branding customization
Multi-language support for international guests & contractors
stats: Eliminates 70% of inbound customer service calls
